Adventure time - anime style! by Suihara (link in the comments)

My team was on an overnight reconnaissance and surveillance mission North of Marjah, Afghanistan. There wasn't a clear abandoned compound near our objective, so our hidesite was for the most part ranger graves with smocks worn over ppe and cammie netting used to conceal the long guns. On this particular mission, the rest of the team held up about 50 meters back to cover our six, while the team leader and I advanced forward and set in at the FFP to cover the objective. Being the primary observer, in addition to a long gun I carried the LRTV thermals and tripod, which were obviously set up as soon as the FFP was occupied.

I always liked occupying a desert hide because of the field of view, as opposed to occupying a compound. Without going into too much detail, the thermals gave great resolution and situational awareness. It would get kind of creepy though sometimes, with the team leader and I alternating watch it was easy to freak yourself out being the only one awake in the middle of the desert with johhny jihad out causing mischief.

About 20 minutes before my watch the TL frantically wakes me up, talking about a "lycan" he saw milling around near the west side of our objective area. I check it out with the thermals, but don't see anything. At this point I'm thinking he either saw one of the huge mountain dogs the afghans keep to guard their compounds or he just wanted me to take over the watch. Since it was so close to his relief time I ended up just taking over. Around 30 minutes later while scanning the area I see a big white blob moving behind a compound in the same area. As I zoom in the blob disappears behind the compound, I remember thinking (more hoping) that it was just a dog. At this point my crusty eyes are glued to the thermals, scanning mostly to the west. And then I see it, moving faster than any living thing I've ever seen. This thing is running to our east, out into the desert, directly across our field of view. At the speed it's moving at I'm not able to see too much detail, save for the thing's size; it dwarfed the dogs we had so far encountered. It got within a couple hundred meters of our pos before leaping into a compound over a wall to our north east.

I wake up the TL, telling him what happened while eyeing the area the lycan was last seen. Neither of us slept for the rest of the night, and that morning we exfilled. Before we headed back to the OP we were running missions out of I took my element by the compound where the thing leapt into the previous night. The compound appeared to be abandoned, and the wall was about eight feet tall. I could make out some of the tracks leading up to the compound, although the wind destroyed or obscured most of them. They were very far apart, and seemed slightly different than a dogs, while also being larger. I don't know what it was, but I vowed never to take a rest cycle again while out on a mission for the rest of the time we were in that area. That didn't last long as got shot about a week later.

I'm still not comfortable spending a night out in the wilderness without having some type of thermals. You just never know what could be out there.
